about: The numerics-relevant set of each certification reference lock: the packages whose builds can change what MEEP or the GPU route computes. tools/compare_reference_environment.py judges every name below against the lock files of its platform (conda packages by version and build, PyPI packages by version, origin and, where pypi_build_tags names one, the wheel's build tag) and does not judge the rest of the lock, the compilers included: the build scripts' step 1b holds the build to every artifact of the lock. Package versions live in the lock files; this file adds only what a lock cannot hold: the MEEP the reference builds from source (meep, judged by tools/check_install.py --require-reference, which imports it), the certified environment's own build of a package the lock takes differently by design (by_design), and wheel build tags.

osx-arm64.basis: MEASURED 2026-10-03: the libraries the certified libmeep and its Python module load (otool closure), the BLAS/LAPACK and OpenMP runtimes NumPy and MEEP reach, the MPI stack, and the Python numerics.

hdf5.why: the certified environment holds this nompi build of hdf5; the lock takes the mpi_openmpi build because a nompi HDF5 deadlocks multi-rank MEEP output

linux-64.basis: The Apple silicon set carried over to the Linux packages (libstdcxx for libcxx, libgomp for llvm-openmp, since the Linux MEEP is configured --with-openmp), the UCX/UCC transports of the Linux Open MPI, and the CUDA libraries of the GPU route; checked 2026-10-03 against readelf -d of the round environment's libmeep.so and _meep.so, whose every NEEDED library belongs to a judged package.
